fieldValues.title: Where does the protocol runner live?
fieldValues.thinking_reached: Raised by the project definition (Research: Protocol evolution, part 5). No option chosen.
fieldValues.tensions:
Options, none chosen:
- A. In the engine: srs protocol run does what the lab runner does.
- B. In the clerk, as tooling over the engine.
- C. Its own package, shipped with the minutes package.
- D. In the browser editor, as the meeting panel.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Whether other consumers (the unit walk, domain refinement) want the same runner; who maintains the model call.
fieldValues.next_action: Decide before the Tier 1 RFC is written, since it fixes who implements it.
